text: The report mentions a lump, mass or nodule. Ask your doctor what type it is, its size, and whether it needs further tests.
The report uses words that need quick specialist review. Do not wait: show it to a doctor soon.
Abnormal cell changes were mentioned. Follow-up tests are usually needed. Ask when.
Bleeding is mentioned. Note how heavy it is (pads per day) and for how many days, and tell your doctor.
A cyst is mentioned. Ask its size and type, and when to repeat the scan.
A fibroid is mentioned. Ask whether it needs treatment or only watching.
A pregnancy risk condition is mentioned. Attend every scheduled check-up and learn the warning signs.
Ectopic pregnancy is an emergency. Seek medical care immediately.
